notes.title: Drill Keeper Digs Into the "Games Baked in Germany" Event!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dirt Dwellers![/h1]

Exciting news from the depths of development! Drill Keeper is part of the "Games Baked in Germany" event on Steam, running from June 20 to June 27. 

The "Games Baked in Germany" event kicks off on June 20 at 19:00 CEST with a special showcase on Steam and IGN's YouTube channel. It’s a celebration of the best games developed in Germany, and  I'm thrilled to be part of this lineup.

notes.title: Drill Keeper digs deep with Manor Lords‘ publisher Hooded Horse
notes.content:
Hello Dirt Dwellers,

After more than 3 years of working solo on Drill Keeper, I’m thrilled to announce that I’ve drilled into a partnership with [b]Hooded Horse[/b], my new publisher! They’re renowned for their dedication to quality and great catalog of deep and system-driven strategy games (e.g., like [i]Manor Lords[/i], [i]Against the Storm[/i] or [i]Terra Invicta[/i]).

Importantly, this collaboration won’t change the creative direction of the game — it’s about making Drill Keeper the best game it can be. With Hooded Horse's support, I have the opportunity to develop the game without compromising it‘s unique identity or rush the development while also learning from their vast experience. Rest assured, I truly couldn’t think of a better partner than Hooded Horse to come along for this ride.

In light of this collaboration, I’ve decided to [b]extend the development timeline to 2025[/b]. This additional time will help me refine the game, mine out any lingering bugs, add exciting new features, and polish every facet to diamond-like brilliance. I know this might be disappointing for some of you who have been eagerly waiting, but this extra time will allow me to make the game better than I ever anticipated.

Thank you so much for sticking with me on this journey. Your support has kept me drilling forward, and I can’t wait to show you what’s coming next year.

Drill safe,
Denno / ShoulderByte
